audience: developers and sysadmins who run instances, Kubernetes and DNS on Exoscale

useCases.title: List the instances in a zone and their state
useCases.text: The AI lists compute instances of a zone with state, type, IP addresses and security groups, and reads one in detail. You get an inventory per zone.

useCases.title: Check how close you are to your quotas
useCases.text: The AI reads the usage and the limit of each resource quota, such as instances, volumes and elastic IPs.

useCases.title: Break down last month's usage by product
useCases.text: The AI reads the usage report for one month with product, quantity and unit per line, and groups it for you.

useCases.title: Check the DNS records of a domain
useCases.text: The AI lists your DNS domains and the records of one domain: name, type, content, TTL and priority.

useCases.title: Start, stop or reboot an instance
useCases.text: The AI starts a stopped instance, stops or reboots a running one, and then checks the state of the operation until it ends.

useCases.title: Review firewall rules, elastic IPs and volumes
useCases.text: The AI lists security groups, with their rules when the API includes them, elastic IPs, and block storage volumes with the instance each one is attached to.
